propositions: Claim-session provenance fields (claimed_session, claim_harness, claim_remote_session) are set on open→in_progress transition but never cleared on exit from in_progress, causing closed/blocked/reopened tickets to retain stale holder information

The reducer must clear all three provenance fields to None whenever a ticket exits in_progress status (to any of closed, blocked, open, or idea), applying the clear only in winning STATUS folds to prevent losing concurrent transitions from clearing the winner's state
All consumers of the three provenance keys are pure passthrough with no branching logic, making the clearing change behavior-safe and backward-compatible with no event schema changes
The clearing mechanism must be invoked in both the normal-update and fork-winner branches of the status processor, mirroring the existing fork-winner gating pattern used by _fold_claimed_session
